ld:
vitaWanted is a clone of the popular minigame "Wanted!" included in Super Mario 64 DS.
Like in the original minigame, timer will start with 10 seconds and you'll have to find the correct face as soon as you can.
Each time you tap the wrong frace, you'll lose 3 seconds and each time you tap the correct one you gain 5 seconds.
The game increases automatically the difficulty and it ends when you run out of time.

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
